description: This file contains functions for device upgrade procedures and partition management, including platform checks and upgrade steps for an embedded device running OpenWrt.

methods.name: mbl_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks the partition layout of the device against an image to determine if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: mbl_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for the device, including partition comparison and image writing.

methods.name: mbl_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the device partition.
